notes.title: Introducing Our New Game - Death By FrostByte
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Crash Landers![/h3]

We are here to announce the development of our brand new game Death By FrostByte!

Death By FrostByte will be releasing on Steam around Q1 of 2021 in Early Access.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1447710/Death_By_FrostByte/

[h2]About The Game[/h2]

After years of scorching heat, an incoming frost is on the horizon, putting half the planet into another Ice Age. Most of the land has been taken over by ice, which forced many cities to relocate. The mining industry has been severely impacted by the lack of space. With demand for more mining on the rise, you set out for the arctic to start your mining industry.

Your goal is to build a colony of workers to mine resources and manufacture parts while surviving the harsh climate. Research new technologies, build up your industry and survive with limited resources.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34663520/e69ae7e2a551cdf91ec3afc94590942f671d1e22.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34663520/630dd2f4057a3d285573fa66033a5a98225fa730.png[/img]

Have a good day!

Storme Games

notes.title: Game Official Release Date / Press Release
notes.content:
[b]Hello Crash Landers![/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34663520/9cd2b70e16dc652d8be70484d5588dbeeeaf09b8.png[/img]
[h1]Official Release Date[/h1]
The official release date for BreakFest is set for March 22 2019. We have gone back and fourth with the dates because our steam page was set up at the last minute, whoops. Plus, this is our first game so expect more in the future, you can follow us on Twitter for more updates.

[h1]Press Release[/h1]
If you are a YouTube, blogger, reviewer, curator and you want to check out BreakFest. Now Is The Time! If you are interested or have any question, you can contact us at Storm1475@outlook.com

notes.title: Demo Is Now LIVE!!

[h1]Hello Crash Landers![/h1]
We are exited to announce that the demo is now available for download! Suprise!

The reason why we moved the demo launch date by two weeks is pretty simple:
- This is our first game being released on steam so we were unsure when we were able to release a demo. ( YES, We are noobs :)
- And why not!

The full release of BreakFest is just around the corner! So stick around, add BreakFest to your wishlist and be ready for the Bacon Invasion!

Storme Games Out.
